secrets.name: SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase project URL (found in Supabase Dashboard → Project Settings → API). Optional for local dev — the app runs with a local Postgres + Express data API.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase anon key (found in Supabase Dashboard → Project Settings → API). Optional for local dev.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase service role key (found in Supabase Dashboard → Project Settings → API). Optional for local dev.

secrets.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
secrets.description: Anthropic Claude API key (from console.anthropic.com). Optional — app falls back to local neural engine without it.

secrets.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
secrets.description: OpenAI API key (from platform.openai.com). Optional — app falls back to local neural engine without it.

secrets.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Google Gemini API key (from ai.google.dev). Optional — app falls back to local neural engine without it.

secrets.name: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
secrets.description: OpenRouter API key (from openrouter.ai). Optional — app falls back to local neural engine without it.

secrets.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
secrets.description: Google OAuth client ID (from Google Cloud Console → Credentials). Optional — only needed for Google sign-in.

secrets.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET
secrets.description: Google OAuth client secret (from Google Cloud Console → Credentials). Optional — only needed for Google sign-in.
